title: HKD-ACPA: Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation Adversarial Cyber-Physical Attacks in Power Grids
abstract: arXiv:2611.29418v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning-based algorithms assist power-grid control centers in localizing transmission-line attacks, yet existing adversarial attacks typically require white-box access or repeated online queries. We study a practical zero-query setting in which an adversary coordinates physical, denial-of-service (DoS), and false data injection (FDI) attacks using only local measurements and historical detector outputs. To bridge the input-view asymmetry between local adversarial observations and DoS-masked control-center measurements, we propose Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation Adversarial Cyber-Physical Attacks (HKD-ACPA). HKD-ACPA distills historical detector predictions into a heterogeneous graph surrogate ensemble and trains a residual calibration module to correct the view-induced logit discrepancy. translated_title: HKD-ACPA：电网中的异构知识蒸馏对抗性信息物理攻击
translated_abstract: 基于学习的算法可辅助电网控制中心定位输电线路攻击，然而现有的对抗性攻击通常需要白盒访问权限或反复的在线查询。我们研究了一个实用的零查询设定：攻击者仅利用本地测量数据和历史检测器输出，即可协调实施物理攻击、拒绝服务攻击和虚假数据注入攻击。为弥合本地对抗性观测与被DoS遮蔽的控制中心测量之间的输入视图不对称性，我们提出了异构知识蒸馏对抗性信息物理攻击。HKD-ACPA将历史检测器预测蒸馏为一个异构图代理集成模型，并训练残差校准模块以纠正视图引起的logit偏差。在该校准代理之上，我们构建了稀疏且幅度受限的FDI合成方法，采用组平衡目标共同引发漏检……
tldr: 该论文提出HKD-ACPA框架，在无需白盒访问或在线查询的实际条件下，通过异构知识蒸馏与残差校准构建代理模型，协调物理、DoS与FDI攻击以诱使电网攻击定位检测器产生漏检。
